correctness.rationale: Direct AYBE expansion forces U²=λU, V²=μV, VU=λV+μU, and associativity forces λμ=0, with converse by substitution. The three normalization cases are exhaustive; matrix-unit coordinate isomorphisms establish equivalence with the exact weight-zero Rota–Baxter identity. Elementary image-kernel flags yield the finite-field Gaussian-binomial counts, and scalar factor rescaling is accounted for exactly once. A standalone finite-field checker directly verifies the original equations on all nonzero factor pairs in M₂ over F₂,F₃,F₄ and all admitted factor pairs in M₃ over F₂; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The Segre (pure-tensor) locus is a mathematically canonical first stratum of the associative Yang–Baxter equation, and elementary multipliers are an independently natural Rota–Baxter class. The complete classification gives a sharp universal square-zero rigidity statement and a full all-size rank distribution up to n⌊n/2⌋ over finite fields. Prior rank-one-as-operator counts do not determine the higher-rank fibers, so this answers a naturally motivated invariant question rather than re-listing a known special case.
